        AND ResourceTypeId = 144 
)
,cte1 AS
(
    SELECT ResourceTypeId AS T1, ResourceSurrogateId AS Sid1
    FROM dbo.TokenSearchParam
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM cte0 WHERE ResourceTypeId = T1 AND ResourceSurrogateId = Sid1)
        AND SearchParamId = 1218
        AND SystemId = @p1
        AND Code = @p2 
        AND ResourceTypeId = 144 
)
,cte2 AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT TOP (@p3) T1, Sid1, 1 AS IsMatch, 0 AS IsPartial 
    FROM cte1
    ORDER BY T1 ASC, Sid1 ASC
)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.ResourceTypeId, r.ResourceId, r.Version, r.IsDeleted, r.ResourceSurrogateId, r.RequestMethod, CAST(IsMatch AS bit) AS IsMatch, CAST(IsPartial AS bit) AS IsPartial, r.IsRawResourceMetaSet, r.SearchParamHash, r.RawResource
FROM dbo.Resource r
     JOIN cte2 ON r.ResourceTypeId = cte2.T1 AND r.ResourceSurrogateId = cte2.Sid1
WHERE IsHistory = 0 
    AND IsDeleted = 0
